title: On-demand shader compilation blocking game thread
fix_rationale: In editor builds, shader compilation is temporary. In packaged builds, cooking all material permutations prevents runtime shader compiler stalls.
evidence_template: {timer} consumed {ms} ms on the GameThread ({share}% of excess time) waiting for shader compilation.

fixes.text: Editor: Allow background shader compilation to complete before profiling, or connect to a shared Derived Data Cache (DDC).
Packaged Build: Ensure all shader formats and quality levels are pre-cooked into the Global Shader Cache.
Avoid runtime material parameter modifications that force new shader permutations.

verify: Re-run after shaders have compiled or in a fully cooked Test build; confirm shader compiling scopes disappear.
caveats: Shader compilation spikes during editor playback are normal and do not affect cooked packaged builds.
